content: मानः [मन्-घञ्] .²1 Respect, honour, regard, respectful consideration; दारिद्र्यस्य परा मूर्तिर्यन्मानद्रविणाल्पता <ls>Pt. 2. 159</ls>; <ls>Bg. 6. 7</ls>; so मानधन <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Pride (in a good sense), self-reliance, self-respect; जन्मिनो मानहीनस्य तृणस्य च समा गतिः <ls>Pt. 1. 106</ls>; <ls>R. 19. 81</ls>. .²3 Haughtiness, pride, conceit, self-confidence, vanity; मानाद् रावणः परदारान् अप्रयच्छन् (विननाश) <ls>Kau. A. 1. 6</ls>. .²4 A wounded sense of honour. .²5 Jealous anger, anger excited by jealousy (especially in women); anger in general; मुञ्च मयि मानमनिदानम् <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>; माधवे मा कुरु मानिनि मानमये <ls n="Gīt.">9</ls>; त्यजत मानमलं वत विग्रहैः <ls>R. 9. 47</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 84</ls>; <ls>Bv. 2. 56</ls>; <ls>Dk. 2. 3</ls>. .²6 Opinion, conception. .²7 <ab>Ved.</ab> Object, purpose. .{@-नम्@} [मा-ल्युट्] .²1 Measuring. .²2 A measure, standard; मानाधीना मेयसिद्धिः Mīmāṃsā; निराकृतत्वाच्छ्रुतियुक्तिमानतः <ls>A. Rām. 7. 5. 57</ls>. .²3 Dimension, computation. .²4 A standard of measure, measuring rod, rule; परिमाणं पात्रमानं संख्यैकद्यादिसंज्ञिका <ls>Śukra. 2. 344</ls>. .²5 Proof, authority, means of proof or demonstration; येऽमी माधुर्यौजः प्रसादा रसमात्रधर्मतयोक्तास्तेषां रसधर्मत्वे किं मानम् <ls>R. G.</ls>; मानाभावात् (frequently occuring in controversial language) <ls>Pad. D. 4. 3</ls>. .²6 Likeness, resemblance.
